faq.a1: Cha. I-DeHub ku-dehub.io iyinkundla yezokuxhumana yomthombo ozimele. Ingosi yabafundi ye-DePaul University, i-DEHub ye-Rowan ne-app yokungena emnyango ye-deHUB yimikhiqizo engahlobene eyenzeka yabelane ngegama.
faq.a2: Yebo. I-DeHub ikhululekile ukudawuniloda ku-Google Play naku-App Store, futhi ikhululekile ukuyisebenzisa kubhrawuza ku-dehub.io.
faq.a3: Izingcingo ze-Android nge-Google Play noma ukudawuniloda okuqondile kwe-APK, i-iPhone nge-App Store, nanoma iyiphi ideskithophu yesimanje noma ibhrawuza yeselula ku-dehub.io.
faq.a4: Yebo. Isakhiwo sakamuva se-Android sishicilelwe yi-DeHub njengokudawuniloda okuqondile kwe-APK ku-dehub.io/apk, ye-Android 8 nangaphezulu.
faq.a5: Thumela ku-feed elandelanayo, iya bukhoma noma ubuke ukusakazwa bukhoma, uthumelele abangane imiyalezo enokubethela kokuphela kokuphela, ujoyine futhi uqhube imiphakathi, ubambe amathokheni esikhwameni esakhiwe ngamaketanga amaningi futhi uthole imivuzo ngokubuka.
faq.q4: Ngingakwazi ukufaka i-DeHub ku-Android ngaphandle kwe-Google Play?

faq.a1: Yebo. I-DeHub imahhala ukujoyina futhi imahhala ukuphosta, futhi ukwakha ukusakaza ochungechungeni akuphoqelekile. Ukungenisa ishaneli kuyakhokhwa, futhi inani layo liyaboniswa ngaphambi kokuba ukhokhe.
faq.a2: Cha. Qhubeka usakaza lapho izithameli zakho zikhona namuhla futhi wakhe ku-DeHub eceleni kwayo. Okuthunyelwe okuvela kumqambi we-DeHub ukuze zonke izinkundla ozisebenzisayo kakade zibuyisele amaphuzu kubalaleli onabo.
faq.a3: Yebo. Khetha i-OBS uma uhamba bukhoma futhi i-DeHub ikunikeza ukhiye wokusakaza unomphela we-OBS, i-Streamlabs noma iyiphi ikhodi ye-RTMP. Ungaya bukhoma ngokuqondile efonini yakho, kubhrawuza yakho noma ekhadini lokuthwebula.
faq.a4: Izibukeli zicebisa futhi zithumele izipho phakathi nokusakazwa kwakho, futhi lezo zihlala ku-chain ngamathokheni e-DeHub ziqonde esikhwameni sakho semali. Ukufaka kungaphinde kube mahhala, kukhokhwe ngokubuka ngakunye noma kunamathokheni.
faq.a5: Vula ikhasi lobulungu ukuze uthole ilinki yakho. Noma ubani ojoyina ngawo kuthiwa uwena, futhi uhola u-20% womsebenzi wakhe kanye no-5% ophindaphindiwe kubantu abamemayo, okhokhelwa ngamathokheni e-DeHub.
faq.q2: Ingabe kufanele ngiyeke ukusakaza ku-TikTok noma ku-Twitch?

streamPage.heading: Sakaza ku-DeHub
streamPage.howToStart: Bhalisa, vula umqambi wephosti bese uthepha okuthi Iya bukhoma — kusuka kukhamera yakho, i-OBS noma ekhadini lokuthwebula.
streamPage.intro: Letha izethameli zakho ezibukhoma enkundleni onayo. Iya bukhoma efonini yakho, ibhrawuza yakho noma i-OBS, thola amacebiso ku-chain ngenkathi usakaza, futhi ugcine izithameli ozakhayo. I-DeHub yakhiwe yiqembu elingemuva kwe-First Class Agency, i-ejensi esemthethweni yase-UK ephathelene ne-TikTok BUKHOMA, enabantu abangaphezu kuka-1,000 abasakaza bukhoma.
streamPage.moreGuides: Ivela ku-TikTok? Funda <tiktok> umhlahlandlela womsunguli wase-UK wokushiya i-TikTok</tiktok> no- <live>Web3 ukusakaza bukhoma: okunye okuhlukile kwe-Twitch okungamiselwanga </live>.

proof.label3: ukubambezeleka komhlaba wonke ku-CDN ka-DeHub uqobo

reasons.body1: Izibukeli zicebisa futhi zithumele izipho ngenkathi ubukhoma, ezinezithombe zezipho ezinamabanga nemiyalezo yamacebiso efundwa ngokuzwakalayo ekusakazweni. Amacebiso axazulula on-chain ngamathokheni e-DeHub futhi afike ngokuqondile esikhwameni sakho semali kunokuncishiswa endleleni.
reasons.body2: Abalandeli bakho abawona umugqa kudathabheyisi yomunye umuntu. Ukusakazwa nokufakwayo kungafakwa ku-chain ku-wallet yakho, i-feed ilandelana ngokulandelana kwezikhathi, futhi ikhodi ivulekile, ngakho akekho obhala kabusha imithetho ngokuthula.
reasons.body3: Ilinki yakho yesimemo ikukhokhela u-20% womsebenzi wawo wonke umuntu ojoyina kuyo, kanye no-5% ophindaphindiwe kubantu abaqhubeka bemema, okhokhelwa ngamathokheni e-DeHub.
reasons.body4: Bungaza Izigaba zomsindo ezibukhoma zemibuzo, imibuthano yokubambisana nokubuka amaphathi. Memezela eyodwa kusenesikhathi ngekhadi izethameli zakho ezingabelana ngalo, futhi ulalele okurekhodiwe.
reasons.body5: Xhuma amanye ama-akhawunti akho kanye bese ushicilela ku-X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Farcaster nakwezinye izinkundla eziyisishiyagalombili usebenzisa umbhali we-DeHub. Gcina i-TikTok njengenjini yakho yokutholwa ngenkathi wakha izethameli ezingezakho.
reasons.body6: Ngenisa isiteshi sonke se-YouTube, noma iphrofayili ye-TikTok, i-Vimeo noma i-SoundCloud, ngeqoqo elilodwa. Inani eliqondile liboniswa ngamathokheni e-DeHub ngaphambi kokuba ukhokhe.
reasons.title3: Thola imali kuwo wonke umuntu oza naye

accountConnect.what: Bhrawuza amaphosti namaphrofayili omphakathi. Ngoxhumano lwe-akhawunti ye-OAuth, lawula iphrofayili yakho nobumfihlo, shicilela amaphosti namakhomenti, landela abantu, funda izaziso, gcina amabhukumaka futhi ukhiqize izithombe, ividiyo, okulalelwayo nezimpahla ze-3D. tasks.privateTitle: Izinhlabathi zazo zinabuyekezwa kwenye ubuye wasekela
tasks.title: Nikeza i-ejenti umsebenzi
tasks.eachHelp: Thumela le miyalo kuwo wonke ama-ejenti akhethiwe. I-ejenti ngayinye yenza umsebenzi ophelele ngesikhathi esiceliwe. Imikhawulo yokuthumela eyabiwe isasebenza.
tasks.allCategories: Konke okuthunyelwe kuzo zonke izigaba. Ayikho isihlungi samagama angukhiye futhi awukho umkhawulo wemisebenzi emithathu yokuthanda.
tasks.windowLimits: Konke okuthunyelwe okufanayo kufakwa emgqeni. Imikhawulo yesenzo ilawula ukwenziwa; ayiwunciphisi umsebenzi ube okuthunyelwe okuthathu. Ukubhala izimpendulo kungase kusebenzise amakhredithi.
tasks.promptLimits: Izicelo zokuthunyelwe ngakunye zisebenzisa zonke izigaba. Ukuthanda okukhethiwe okusekelwe esihlokweni kulinganiselwe kokuthathu ngomzamo ngamunye. Wonke ama-ejenti abelana ngebanga lokuthumela; ukubhala kungase kusebenzise amakhredithi.
tasks.reviewMembers: Imisebenzi enezinyathelo ezingaqinisekile idinga ukubuyekezwa ngakunye ngaphambi kokuqalisa kabusha. Isenzo esivele siqhubeka singase siqedwe ngemva kokumisa isikhashana noma ukukhansela.
tasks.enabledHelp: Kunikwe amandla kusho ukuthi le ejenti iyatholakala. Izimo zomsebenzi ngezansi zibonisa ukuthi iyasebenza, iyalinda, imisiwe isikhashana noma yehlulekile.
tasks.swarmHelp: Umsebenzi owodwa osheshayo, ohlanganyelwayo. Imigomo eminingi ihlukaniswe phakathi kwama-ejenti; amaphosti ashejuliwe ajikeleza kuwo.
tasks.description: Izenzo ziqhutshwa njenge-ejenti ekhethiwe. Imisebenzi eshejuliwe iyaqhubeka nge-app ivaliwe.
tasks.limits: Iphosti eyodwa yansuku zonke nokuthandwa okufika ku-3 okufanelekile ngomsebenzi ngamunye. Wonke ama-ejenti abelana ngegebe lephosti lemizuzu engu-20. Izithombe zisebenzisa izincazelo ezihloliwe; amavidiyo adinga isithombe sendlu. Amaphosti ahlala ngaphansi kwezinhlamvu ezingu-500. Ayikho igesi ngaphandle kwalapho kudwetshwa; ukubhala kungasebenzisa amakhredithi.
tasks.createFirst: Yakha i-ejenti ngezansi ukuze uyinikeze umsebenzi.

workspace.moderationHelp: Qala ngokuvula imvume yokuphatha. I-akhawunti kumele kakade ibe ngumdali wokusakaza noma umphathi owabelwe. Izindlela zokugunyaza nezedrafti zisasebenza. Ukumiswa kwesikhashana kuyaphela ngokuzenzakalelayo.
workspace.webhookHelp: Izicelo zokugunyaza nezenzo ezehlulekile zithumela isaziso esijwayelekile, kungadluli kanye ngehora. Akukho mbhalo wedrafti noma imininingwane yesikhwama ethunyelwayo. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze ukuvale; imiphumela yokulethwa ivela kulogi yokucwaninga.
workspace.reversalHelp: Ukuhoxisa kufihla okuthunyelwe, kususa amazwana unomphela, kubuyisela ukusabela nombhalo wephrofayela, noma kukhansela ukulandela okusha. Ukubuka, izaziso esezilethiwe, imisebenzi yezimali eyenziwe ku-chain, izithombe zephrofayela nokumiswa kwesikhashana okusekuphelile akunakususwa. Okuthunyelwe okufihliwe kusengabuyiswa ngezilawuli zokubonakala kwakho.
workspace.confirmCorrection: Lokhu kushintsha umsebenzi oshicilelwe. Ukususwa kwamazwana akubuyeleki.
workspace.scope: Lezi zilawuli zisebenza emisebenzini ehleliwe, empilweni ezimele nakubasizi abaxhunyiwe. Amadrafti ahlala eyimfihlo uze uwagunyaze.

dao.title: Isikhwama se-DAO
dao.subtitle: Isikhwama esisodwa, esixhaswa umphakathi, esichithwa yivoti yaso
dao.contributeIntro: Thumela izibhalwa ze-DeHub kusuka kusikhwama sakho kuya kumgcinimafa. Isibhalwa ngasinye osifakayo sikhuphula isabelo sakho echibini, futhi isabelo sakho siyisisindo sokuvota kwakho lapho i-DAO inquma ukuthi zisetshenziswa kanjani.
dao.irreversible: Iminikelo ukudluliswa okusemthethweni. Ayikwazi ukubuyiselwa emuva noma ukukhutshwa.
dao.switchChain: Shintshela i-wallet yakho ku- {{chains}} ukuze unikele.
dao.sentDesc: Izibhalwa ezingama-{{amount}} zithunyelwe kumgcinimafa ngo-{{chain}}. Isabelo sakho sibuyekezwa uma ibhulokhi isingenisiwe.
dao.sendAnyWallet: Noma ubani angathumela izibhalwa ze-DeHub lapha kusuka kunoma yisiphi isikhwama noma indawo yokushintshana. Ukudluliswa ku-Base naku-BNB kubalwa esabelweni sakho.
dao.loadFailed: Ayikwazanga ukufunda isikhwama manje. Zama futhi emizuzwini embalwa.
dao.noContributionYet: Awukanikeli okwamanje. Isabelo sakho echibini siqala ngokudluliswa kwakho kokuqala.
dao.howItWorksBody: Amandla akho ngumnikelo wakho ohlukaniswe konke okwake kwathunyelwa esikhwameni. Ifundwa ngqo kusuka ku-chain, ayiphelelwa yisikhathi, futhi inquma ukuthi izwi lakho linamandla kangakanani lapho i-DAO ivota ngokuchitha.
dao.votingPowerNote: Ukuvota kuhlala izinsuku eziyi-7. Amandla okuvota yisamba samathokheni esinikezwe umnikelo ngamunye lapho le ncwadana ivulwa. Okungenani okungu-10% kufanele kuhlanganyele futhi Okwamukelayo kufanele kudlule Okwenqatshelwe.

arcade.intro: Iqoqo lemidlalo, imihlaba nezipiliyoni ezakhiwe futhi zavulwa umthombo yi-DeHub.
arcade.seoDescription: Dlala ngqo kusiphequluli sakho ku-DeHub — i-chess ye-3D enjengefilimu, umdlalo wokudubula owakhiwe ngokwezinqubo, ukuhamba ehlathini lemvula, ukulwa emgwaqweni kwe-neon nephansi lokuhweba ongahamba kulo. Akukho ukufaka, akukho ukulanda.

unavailable.title: Izibalo azitholakali okwamanje
unavailable.unconfigured: Indawo yokugcina yokuhlaziya ayikanikwa ithokheni yayo ye-Cloudflare API. Akukho okuboniswayo esikhundleni senani eliqanjiwe.
unavailable.error: Asikwazanga ukufinyelela i-API yokuhlaziya ye-Cloudflare. Kunokuba ibonise inani elidala noma eliqanjiwe, leli khasi alibonisi lutho kuze kuphumelele ukufunda bukhoma.

proof.title: Lapho lezi zibalo zivela khona
proof.subtitle: Kulinganiswe yi-Cloudflare, hhayi yileli khasi
proof.edge: Sonke isicelo esiya ku-dehub.io sidlula ku-Cloudflare ngaphambi kokuba sifike kuma-server ethu. Lezi zibalo ziwukuhlanganiswa kwe-Cloudflare ngokwayo kwaleyo thrafikhi — amanani afanayo abonisa ideshibhodi yethu. Aziqoqwa umbhalo esipheqululini sakho, ngakho akukho lutho kuleli khasi olungawakhulisa, futhi ukuvimba abalandeli akuwashintshi.
proof.live: Ikhasi liwafunda bukhoma. Ukulayisha i-/stats kubiza indawo yethu yokugcina, ebuza i-Analytics API ye-Cloudflare ngaleso sikhathi bese igcina impendulo imizuzwana engu-60.
proof.limits: Okuboniswa yilokhu nokungaboniswa: ungabona ukuthi amanani avela ekuhlanganisweni kwe-Cloudflare hhayi kukhodi yohlelo lwethu, nokuthi umbuzo oshicilelwe lapha yiwona osebenzayo. Akuyona into engadingi ukwethemba — ithokheni ye-API sinayo, futhi i-Cloudflare ayinikezi ukufunda komphakathi kokuhlaziya kwendawo. Noma ubani onendawo yakhe ye-Cloudflare angasebenzisa umbuzo ofanayo futhi aqinisekise isakhiwo sawo.

definitions.title: Okushiwo yilezi zibalo
definitions.visitors: — amakheli e-IP ahlukile i-Cloudflare eyawabona ngalolo suku. Kusondele kubantu, kodwa akufani: ihhovisi elikuxhumano olulodwa libalwa kanye, futhi ifoni eshintsha phakathi kwe-wifi nedatha yeselula ibalwa kabili.
definitions.pageViews: — izicelo i-Cloudflare eziqoqa njengokulayishwa kwamakhasi, hhayi izithombe, imibhalo noma amakholi we-API.
definitions.bots: — lezi yizibalo ezingahluziwe emaphethelweni, ngakho ama-crawler, abaqaphi bokusebenza namaklayenti anemibhalo akufakiwe. Ungazibona wena kubunjalo besiphequluli ngenhla, lapho okufakiwe okufana no-"Curl" no-"Akwaziwa" kuyithrafikhi ezenzakalelayo hhayi abantu. Ukuhlunga ama-bot kudinga uhlelo lwe-Cloudflare olukhokhelwayo esingenalo, futhi ukususa isilinganiso buthule kwenza izibalo zingahloleki kalula, hhayi kangcono.
definitions.total: — ukubukwa kwamakhasi nezicelo kuyahlanganiswa kulo lonke ibanga. Izibalo zezivakashi azihlanganiswa ngamabomu zibe "yisamba sezivakashi", ngoba umuntu obelapha ngoMsombuluko nangoLwesibili ubezobalwa kabili.
definitions.peak: — inani eliphakeme kunawo wonke elihlukile kunoma yisiphi isikhathi esisodwa sebanga, ngesizathu esifanayo: yinani i-Cloudflare eyilinganisa ngempela, hhayi elakhiwe ngokuhlanganisa izibalo ezigqagqanayo.
definitions.resolution: — lona umkhawulo we-Cloudflare kulolu hlelo, hhayi ukukhetha kwethu: yenqaba noma yimuphi umbuzo wamahora obanzi kunezinsuku ezintathu. Ukubuka kwamahora angu-24 nezinsuku ezingu-3 kungokwamahora; izinsuku ezingu-7 nangaphezulu kungokwansuku zonke, futhi ayikho indlela yokudweba ishadi lamahora lesikhathi sonke.
definitions.breakdown: — alandela ibanga olikhethayo, kodwa kuphela izinsuku ezingu-{{max}} emuva, ngoba yilapho ukuhlukaniswa kwansuku zonke kugcinwa khona. Emabangeni amade ishadi limboza isikhathi esingaphezu kohlu lwamazwe.
definitions.start: — "isikhathi sonke" kusho usuku ngalunye i-Cloudflare esalugcinile, namuhla izinsuku ezingu-{{days}} kusukela ngo-{{date}}, usuku i-dehub.io eyathuthela ngalo ku-Cloudflare. Ayikho idatha yasemaphethelweni yangaphambili engaboniswa, futhi izinsuku ezindala ziyawa njengoba i-Cloudflare izenza zibe ndala.
definitions.estimated: — kusukela {{date}}, i-dehub.io isetshenziswe nge-server ye-relay ukuze amanethiwekhi angakwazi ukufinyelela ku-Cloudflare ngokuqondile asalayisha isayithi. I-Cloudflare bese ibheka izivakashi eziningi njengekheli elilodwa le-RELAY, futhi isibalo sayo esiyingqayizivele siyawohloka. Ngalezo zinsuku ishadi libonisa ukubukwa kwekhasi okulinganisiwe okuphindaphindwe ngesilinganiso esivamile sezivakashi ngekhasi ngalinye se- {{days}} ezinsukwini ezandulele ({{ratio}}%). Ukubukwa kwamakhasi nezicelo kusalinganiswa ngokuqondile, futhi isibalo esingathintwanga se-Cloudflare sisempendulweni eluhlaza exhunywe ngenhla.

superpowers.intro: Ibheji lithenga okungaphezu komdwebo osecaleni kwegama lakho. Njalo ngamaviki amabili linika ukukhuthaza — ngakunye kubeka okuthunyelwe endaweni ephezulu kohla lwasekhaya. Amazinga ayi-13, amandla ayi-13, ukuvulwa okukodwa ngezinga ngalinye.

premium.boostDetail: Amaphosti akho abonwa abantu abaningi abafanele
premium.twentySeatsDetail: Woza nalo lonke iqembu, i-studio noma I-DAO
premium.skyHighAiDetail: I-5,000 Assistant msgs, izithombe ezingu-1,500, imizuzu engu-5 yevidiyo / inyanga ye-AI

premium.diveAdFreeBody: Khipha wonke amaphosti akhushuliwe, wonke amabhanela okuthuthukisa, zonke izikhala ezixhasiwe ku- Hlola. Abantu nabasunguli kuphela oze kubo ngempela.
premium.diveBackgroundBody: Khiya ifoni yakho, shintsha ama-app, gxuma amathebhu — ividiyo nomculo wakho kuyaqhubeka kudlala. Phatha i-DeHub njenge-app yemidiya.
premium.diveAiBody: Imiyalezo engu-500 yomsizi, izithombe ezingu-150 ze-AI, nemizuzwana engu-20 yevidiyo ekhiqizwa njalo ngenyanga. Kwanele ukwakha, ukuthumela nokuthumela — hhayi i-teaser.
premium.faqWhatIsAnAdA: Amaphosti athuthukisiwe kuma-feed akho, amabhanela okuthuthukisa, nezindawo ezixhasiwe ku- Hlola. I-Premium iyasusa zonke.
premium.faqSwitchPlansA: Yebo. Thuthukisa noma wehlise noma nini — amanani akhokhiswayo ngokuzenzakalelayo.
premium.faqFamilySeatsA: Umnikazi umema amagama abasebenzisi angaba ngu-5 e-DeHub. Ilungu ngalinye ligcina i-akhawunti yalo, amabheji, namanani - akukho lutho oluhlanganisiwe noma olwabelwana ngalo.
premium.faqTopTierStakerA: Cha. Amabanga ahamba phambili angu-7 athola i-DeHub Extra mahhala. Amabanga angu-4 ahamba phambili athola i-DeHub Family mahhala. Unstake and the perks lift — restake and they return.
premium.faqPayInDhbA: Izinkokhelo ngekhadi lapho kuqala. Ukukhokha ngamathokheni e-DeHub kuza kungekudala futhi kuzofaka isaphulelo.

jobs.seoTitle: Imisebenzi e-DeHub — Vula Izindima ku-Web3 Social Media
jobs.seoDescription: Joyina iqembu le-DeHub — izikhundla ezivulekile ekuthuthukiseni ibhizinisi, ukumaketha nokuningi.
jobs.heading: Imisebenzi e-DeHub
jobs.subheading: Joyina iqembu elakha ikusasa lezinkundla zokuxhumana ezihlukanisiwe
jobs.intro: Sifuna abantu abanogqozi abafuna ukuba yingxenye yegagasi elilandelayo lezinkundla zokuxhumana — elibeka abasunguli nemiphakathi kuqala. Zonke izindima ziyi- remote with amahora okushintshashintsha nezimo , okukunikeza inkululeko yokusebenza noma kuphi emhlabeni.
jobs.bdmAbout: Njengomunye wabaPhathi bethu Bentuthuko Yebhizinisi e-DeHub, uzoba yingxenye yamandla ashukumisayo endleleni yethu yokubambisana. Umgomo wakho ukuhlonza, ukuhlanganyela, nokuvala amadili nezinkampani kuzo zombili i-Web2 ne-Web3 - kusuka ezitudiyo zemidlalo nezinkundla zokuqukethwe kuya kumaphrojekthi we-blockchain namaphrothokholi e-DeFi. Lesi yisikhundla esisekelwe kukhomishini ye-OTE (On-Target Earnings): uma uba nzima, yilapho uthola imali eningi. Indima ilula, letha izinkampani, amaphrojekthi, imiphakathi noma noma yimaphi ama-akhawunti amaphrofayili amakhulu ku-DeHub, futhi ukhokhelwe. Umqondo uwukuthi, ukuqwashisa okwengeziwe kubangela ukukhula okwengeziwe esimisweni sethu semvelo, okukukhokhela amabhonasi amaningi emikhankasweni ephumelelayo. Kuwukukhula okungenamkhawulo okunethuba lokuthola iholo elinganqunyiwe. Ukuletha abakhangisi enkundleni kuvula amabhonasi engeziwe kanye nesakhiwo sekhomishini ehamba phambili embonini — lapho ushayela inani elithe xaxa, yilapho uthola imali eningi. Ngisho nalabo abangenakho okuhlangenwe nakho bayamenywa ukuba bafake isicelo, uma isimo sengqondo silungele indima.
jobs.bdmResp1: Thola futhi uvikele ubambiswano lwamasu nezinkampani ze-Web2 ne-Web3 ezihambisana nomgomo we-DeHub
jobs.bdmResp2: Yakha futhi umenenje ipayipi labangaba ophathina, abaxhasi, namathuba okuhlanganisa
jobs.bdmResp3: Melela i-DeHub emicimbini yezimboni, izingqungquthela, nezingqungquthela ze-intanethi
jobs.bdmResp4: Xoxa ngemigomo yobambiswano, amamodeli okwabelana ngemali engenayo, nezivumelwano zokumaketha ngokubambisana
jobs.bdmResp5: Sebenzisana namaqembu omkhiqizo nawokumaketha ukuze uthuthukise imikhankaso nokuhlanganiswa okuhlangene
jobs.bdmWant1: Okuhlangenwe nakho okufakazelwe ekuthuthukiseni ibhizinisi, ukubambisana, noma ukuthengisa ngaphakathi kwezobuchwepheshe, imidlalo, noma i-Web3
jobs.bdmWant2: Inethiwekhi enamandla ekhona ku-crypto/Web3 noma endaweni yomnotho womsunguli iyinhlanganisela enkulu
jobs.bdmWant3: Ukuxhumana okuhle namakhono okuxoxisana — ungavala amadili futhi wakhe ubudlelwano obuhlala njalo
jobs.bdmWant4: Ukuzikhuthaza futhi ukhululekile ukusebenza ngokuzimela endaweni ekude
jobs.bdmWant5: Isithakazelo sangempela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ezihlukanisiwe, ama-NFT, noma ubuchwepheshe be-blockchain
jobs.bdmCompensation: Le ndima inikeza iholo eliyisisekelo elixoxwayo kanye nesakhiwo sekhomishini ye-OTEengamboziwe eboshelwe ngokuqondile kubambiswano olulethayo. Abaculi abahamba phambili banethuba lokuthola imali elingenamkhawulo.
jobs.pastExperiencePlaceholder: Sitshele nge-BD yakho efanelekile, ukubambisana, noma okokuzithokozisa kokuthengisa. Faka izinkampani, izimboni, kanye namadili aphawulekayo uma kusebenza...
jobs.whyHireYouPlaceholder: Yini ekwenza ube umuntu ofanele kule ndima? Yiliphi inani eliyingqayizivele oliletha ku-DeHub?
jobs.ambassadorAbout: NjengeNxusa Lebhrendi ye-DeHub ungubuso nezwi lenkundla emphakathini wakini. Umsebenzi wakho ukusakaza igama mayelana ne-DeHub kuzo zonke iziteshi ozithintayo — izinkundla zokuxhumana, imihlangano ye-IRL, imicimbi yokudlala, amakhampasi aseyunivesithi, nangale kwalokho. Le yindima yomholo wenyanga okhokhelwayo, hhayi eyikhomishini; uzothola iholo elingaguquki ngenkathi ukhula eceleni kwepulatifomu.
jobs.ambResp1: Sungula futhi wabelane ngokuqukethwe kwangempela mayelana ne-DeHub kumashaneli akho omphakathi (X, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, njll.)
jobs.ambResp2: Xhumana ngenkuthalo nomphakathi we-DeHub ku-app — ukuphosta, ukuphawula, nokuxhumana nabanye abasebenzisi
jobs.ambResp3: Yiba khona futhi umele i-DeHub emicimbini yangempela, emihlanganweni, nasezingqungqutheleni endaweni yangakini
jobs.ambResp4: Ngenisa abasebenzisi abasha nabasunguli enkundleni ngenethiwekhi yakho
jobs.ambResp5: Nikeza umbiko nemibono evela emphakathini ukuze usize ekwakheni imephu yomgwaqo womkhiqizo
jobs.ambWant1: Ukuba khona kwezinkundla zokuxhumana okusebenzayo nokuzibandakanya kwangempela (inani labalandeli libaluleke kancane kunobuqiniso)
jobs.ambWant2: Ukuthanda i-Web3, i-crypto, imidlalo, noma isiko lomsunguli
jobs.ambWant3: Amakhono okuxhumana anamandla nekhono lokuchaza imiqondo eyinkimbinkimbi kalula
jobs.ambWant4: Ukuziqalisa okwazi ukuhlela nokwenza imikhankaso ngokuzimela
jobs.ambWant5: Inxusa langaphambilini, umgqugquzeli, noma okokuzithokozisa kokuphathwa komphakathi kuyibhonasi
jobs.noRoleFits: Awuyiboni indima efanelana nayo? Thintana nathi ku- <mail>dev@dehub.io</mail> — sihlala sifuna abantu abanamakhono.

depin.seoTitle: I-DePin | Ingqalasizinda Yemidiya Eqhutshwa Umphakathi | I-DeHub
depin.seoDescription: I-DeHub DePin ivumela abantu ukuba banikele ngesitoreji, umkhawulokudonsa kanye nekhompyutha ukuze basize ekubungazeni, ekudluliseni ikhodi futhi bahambise imidiya ngenethiwekhi eqinile.
depin.heroBlurb: Nikela ngesitoreji esingeziwe, umkhawulokudonsa kanye nekhompyutha ukusiza ukubungaza, ukudlulisa ikhodi nokuletha okusunguliwe kwe-DeHub.
depin.heroImageAlt: I-compute node ehlanganisiwe exhunywe emakhaya nasezitudiyo zabasunguli
depin.heroCaption: I-DeHub igcina ikhophi yomsuka. Ama-node omphakathi anezela izinto eziphindaphindekayo kanye nomthamo wokulethwa kwendawo.
depin.earlyAccessBody: I-node engasindi, esekelwe kubhrawuza ibukhoma ngezansi. I-node yedeskithophu esindayo, ehlala ikhona isiqondiso esishiwo sesikhathi esizayo, engakatholakali okwamanje. Ukubamba iqhaza akukaze kuqinisekise umvuzo.
depin.runFromTabBody: Akukho ukufaka, akukho ukudawuniloda. Ngena ngemvume, ngena, bese ithebhu yakho yebhrawuza evulekile iqala ukubamba ikhophi yesibili yezinto ezimbalwa zemidiya ye-DeHub.
depin.signInBlurb: Ngena ngemvume ukuze uguqule le thebhu yebhrawuza ibe yindawo eyisipele engasindi.
depin.optInBlurb: Leli banga lisebenza ngokuphelele kubhrawuza yakho kusetshenziswa isitoreji sendawo (OPFS). Inikela kuphela ngenkathi le thebhu ihlala ivuliwe — iyayivala imisa i-node yakho, bese iyivula kabusha iqala entsha. Akukho ukufaka futhi akukho lutho olusebenza ngemuva.
depin.unsupportedBlurb: Ama-node okugcina amabhrawuza adinga ukwesekwa kwe-Original Private File System, le bhrawuza engakunikezi (lokhu kuvamile ku-Safari). Kunalokho zama i-Chrome yakamuva, i-Edge noma i-Firefox.
depin.rejectedBlurb: Inethiwekhi yenqabile iseshini yale node, ngokuvamile okusho ukuthi iphelelwe yisikhathi ngesikhathi ikhasi livuliwe. Phinda ungene ngemvume futhi ukhethe ukungena — akukho okulahlekile.
depin.threeJobsBody: Abasebenzayo bakhetha imikhawulo yabo yokugcina, yomkhawulokudonsa kanye neye-compute. I-DeHub ihlelela kuphela umsebenzi umshini wayo ongawusingatha ngokuphepha.
depin.transcodeImageAlt: Isiteshi sokusebenzela somsunguli wekhaya esinikela nge-compute ye-GPU engaphelele
depin.transcodeBody: Imishini efanelekayo iguqula ividiyo efakiwe ibe ukuhumusha okuvumelana nezimo. Konke okukhishwayo kuyahlolwa ngaphambi kokuba kudliwe.
depin.hostBody: Ama-node agcina izingxenye ezifihliwe noma ezinamakheli okusunguliwe endaweni enesilondolozi sendawo esinqunyiwe. Isitoreji semvelaphi ye-DeHub sihlala singumthombo weqiniso.
depin.deliverBody: Oontanga abaseduze babelana ngezingxenye zevidiyo kuyilapho indlela evamile yokulethwa ihlala ilungile njengephutha elizenzakalelayo.
depin.nodesLeaveBody: Awukho umshini womphakathi ophethe okuwukuphela kwekhophi. Ukuhlolwa kwezempilo, iziphindaphindiwe kanye nokubuyiswa kwemvelaphi kugcina ukudlala kutholakala.
depin.originBody: Ikhophi yomthombo unomphela nokulethwa kokubuyiselwa emuva
depin.offlineNodeBody: Isusiwe ekwahlukaniseni kuze kube yilapho ixhuma kabusha
depin.viewerBody: Usebenzisa ontanga lapho etholakala, umsuka lapho kudingeka
depin.privacyBody: Imithombo yezindaba evikelwe ibhalwe ngekhodi kuhadiwe yomphakathi. Okhiye bokudlala bakhishwa ngokuhlukile kubabukeli abagunyaziwe.
depin.protectedContentBody: Izingxenye zababhalisile, eziphrayivethi nezikhokhelwayo zingagcinwa njenge-ciphertext. Abasebenza nge-node abatholi okhiye abanelungelo ngenxa nje yokuthi babungaza idatha.
depin.publicContentBody: Ukubethela kuvimbela ukuhlolwa okungahleliwe kwamafayela afihliwe, kodwa imithombo yezindaba yomphakathi ihlala ibukwa ngesidlali somphakathi se-DeHub. Ngeke sikleyime ngenye indlela.
depin.operatorControlsBody: Abasebenzayo bakhetha imikhawulo yediski, imikhawulo yomkhawulokudonsa, amahora okusebenza kanye nezigaba zokuqukethwe zomphakathi ezifanelekayo Izaziso zokususa zibangela ukuhlanzwa kwesilondolozi.
depin.verifiedWorkTitle: Umsebenzi owusizo uqinisekisiwe. Imiklomelo ihlala ishintshashintsha.
depin.verifiedWorkBody: Umnikelo ulinganiswa ngamarisidi asayiniwe, ukuhlolwa kwezempilo nokuqinisekiswa kokukhiphayo. Isitoreji sisodwa asenzi umvuzo.
depin.deliveryReceiptsBody: Amabhayithi aqinisekisiwe anikezwa amaseshini wokudlala wangempela.
depin.availabilityBody: Ukuhlolwa kokubuyisa okuphumelelayo nesevisi enokwethenjelwa lapho yabelwe.
depin.validOutputBody: Amakhodi okudlulisa kufanele adlulise ukuhlolwa kwekhwalithi kwezobuchwepheshe nokwesampula.
depin.revenuePoolBody: Uma ivuliwe, ibhajethi yomvuzo izosethwa emalini engenayo yesiteji ngemva kokuvalwa kwenkathi.
depin.noFixedRate: Akukho mali esethiweyo, inzuzo encinci, i-APY okanye isilinganiselo sangaphambili. Amarekhodi egosa yimfuno yokubala kuphela, hayi isithembiso sokuhlawulwa. Nakuphi na ukuhlawulwa kwe-token okuzayo kuya kwenzeka kwi-Base kwaye kuhlala kuxhomekeke ekufanelekela, imithetho yenethiwekhi kunye nomthetho osebenzayo.
depin.runningCosts: Ukusebenzisa i-node kusebenzisa ugesi, idatha ye-inthanethi nokuphila kwehadiwe. Abasebenzayo bangase bangatholi lutho, futhi izindleko zabo zingadlula noma yimuphi umvuzo.
depin.safestWorkloadTitle: Yakhelwe emthwalweni womsebenzi ophephe kakhulu ngaphandle.
depin.safestWorkloadBody: I-DePin inezela indlela yokulethwa ekhona kakade ye-DeHub kuqala. Imithwalo yomsebenzi enzima kakhulu ilandela kuphela ngemva kokuqinisekiswa kufakazelwe.
depin.deliveryBody: Ukulethwa bukhoma nokulethwa kwevidiyo okusizwa ontanga ngokuzenzakalelayo.
depin.adaptiveVideoBody: Izindlela eziningi zokudlala okunokwethenjelwa ngejubane lokuxhuma.
depin.desktopNodesBody: Isitoreji esinqunyiwe, izilawuli zomkhawulokudonsa kanye nokutholakala okuqinisekisiwe.
depin.baseSettlementBody: Izimangalo ezixhaswe ngemali engenayo kuphela ngemva kokubuyekezwa kokusebenza nokwezomthetho.
depin.faqOfflineQ: Kwenzekani lapho i-node yokubungaza iphuma ku-inthanethi?
depin.faqOfflineA: Umxhumanisi uyayisusa ekuthumeleni okusebenzayo. Enye i-replica isiza ingxenye, noma ukudlala kabusha kubuyela emuva ekulondolozweni kwemvelaphi ye-DeHub kuyilapho amakhophi okubuyisela eshejuliwe.
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeQ: Ingabe umsebenzisi we-node angakubona okusunguliwe akubungazayo?
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeA: Okuqukethwe okuvikelwe kugcinwa njengezingxenye ezifihliwe futhi umbungazi akatholi okhiye bokudlala. Okusunguliwe komphakathi kuhlala kubonakala esidlangalaleni nge-DeHub ngomklamo.
depin.faqHowMuchA: Asikho isilinganiso esinqunyiwe noma isibikezelo. Umnikelo oqinisekisiwe ungathola ingxenye ye-pool yomvuzo exhaswe ngemali engenayo ngemva kokuvalwa kwenkathi. Imivuzo ayiqinisekisiwe, futhi izindleko zikagesi, umkhawulokudonsa nomkhawulokudonsa zingadlula noma yimuphi umvuzo.
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableA: Ibanga elingasindi, elisekelwe kubhrawuza liyatholakala namuhla: ngena ngemvume futhi ukhethe ukungena kuleli khasi, futhi ithebhu yakho evulekile iba yinodi ngenkathi ihlala ivuliwe. I-node yedeskithophu esindayo, ehlala ikhona isiqondiso esishiwo sesikhathi esizayo — ayikho okwamanje.
depin.faqInstallNeededQ: Ingabe kukhona engikudingayo ukufaka i-node yebhrawuza?
depin.faqInstallNeededA: Cha. Isebenza ngokuphelele kuthebhu kusetshenziswa isitoreji sendawo sebhrawuza yakho. Ukuvala ithebhu kumisa i-node yakho; ayikho isevisi yangemuva futhi akukho ukufaka.
depin.ctaBody: Ukwehla komsuka, imidiya evikelwe ebethelwe nomsebenzi oqinisekisiwe kuza ngaphambi kwemivuzo yomphakathi.
depin.footerNote: Ukubamba iqhaza kwe-DePin kuyisevisi yomnikelo, hhayi umkhiqizo wokutshala imali. Ukutholakala, ukufaneleka nemiklomelo kungashintsha.

migrate.costsIntro: Ividiyo ngayinye iligcina kakhulu kuneyangaphambi kwayo — izinga liyehla njengoba ibheshi likhula, ngakho intengo engezansi yilokho okubizwa ngayo ilividiyo elingi.
migrate.costsIntroShort: Ividiyo ngayinye iligcina kakhulu kuneyangaphambi kwayo — izinga liyehla njengoba ibheshi likhula. Intengo enembile ikhombiswe ngaphambi kokuthi ukhokhe.
migrate.costsNote: Kuhlawulwe ii-token ze-DeHub, kanye, ngaphambi kokuba ibhetshi iqale. Abaphetheyo be-badge bahlawula ngaphantsi — isaphulelo sakho sifakwe kwisicatshulwa. Ukuba ividiyo ayinakungeniswa, isabelo sayo sibuyiselwa kwisibuyekezo sakho esilandelayo.

nearBuy.detail_confirming: Ilinde inethiwekhi ukuthi iqinisekise inkokhelo yakho. Akudingeki uphinde ukhokhe.
nearBuy.detail_swapping: Intlawulo yakho iyacutshungulwa. Siza kuhlaziya eli risiti xa ii-token zakho zifikile.
nearBuy.detail_deliveryDelayed: Intlawulo yakho iqhubekile, kodwa ukuhanjiswa kwe-token kufuna ukuzama kwakhona. Gcina le nombolo yokuthenga kwaye unxibelelane nenkxaso ye-DeHub ukuba ihlala icothisiwe. Musa ukuhlawula kwakhona.

nearBuy.detail_refunded: Umhlinzeki ubika inkokhelo ebuyiselwe ekhelini lokubuyiselwa imali elingezansi. Hlola leyo wallet; izindleko zenethiwekhi zingase zisebenze.

nearBuy.detail_checking: Umhlinzeki akakabuyiseli umphumela wokugcina. Ukuthenga kwakho kugciniwe. Ungathumeli enye inkokhelo.

commonGround.title: Umhlaba Ovamile
commonGround.sheetHint: Ikhefu elifushane ngaphambi kokuphendula kwakho. Izimpendulo zakho zihlala ziyimfihlo.
commonGround.toggleHint: Ngaphambi kokuphendula kwabo kokuqala, abafundi bayacelwa iphuzu elinamandla kakhulu kolunye uhlangothi nokuthi bobabili babelana ngani, bese bekhunjuzwa ukuthi bagweme ukucabanga okuthi "noma lokhu noma lokho".
commonGround.banner: Lo mdali uvule imodi Yomhlaba Ovamile. Ngaphambi kokuba uphendule uzocelwa iphuzu elinamandla kakhulu kolunye uhlangothi nokuthi yini eniyihlanganyelayo.
commonGround.step1Title: Ngokomushwana owodwa, yini iphuzu elinamandla kakhulu kolunye uhlangothi?
commonGround.step2Title: Yini enivumelana ngayo wena nabo empeleni?
commonGround.reminderTitle: Qaphela ukucabanga okuthi konke noma akukho lutho
commonGround.reminderBody: Okungavumelani okuningi akukona ukukhetha phakathi kwezinto ezimbili eziphambene. Lapho umbuzo uzwakala sengathi "noma lokhu noma lokho", kuvame ukuba khona inketho yesithathu phakathi.
commonGround.example1: Umakhelwane ofuna umgwaqo othule nokuthi umakhelwane ofuna indawo yokupaka eyengeziwe bangaba nelungelo ngalokho abakudingayo.
commonGround.example2: Abazali ababili bangase bangavumelani ngesikhathi sokusebenzisa izikrini futhi basavumelana ngokuthi ingane kufanele ilele kahle futhi iphumelele esikoleni.
commonGround.noShouting: Izindaba eziyinkimbinkimbi azisoze zahlanganiswa ngokumemeza noma izinsongo. Impendulo ethule, enemininingwane iyona abantu abayifundayo ngempela.
commonGround.privateNote: Izimpendulo zakho zingezakho zodwa futhi azifakwa nempendulo yakho.
commonGround.tooShort: Bhala okungenani izinhlamvu eziyi-10 ukuze ukucabanga kubalwe ngempela.
commonGround.saveFailed: Ayikwazanga ukulondoloza isilungiselelo soMhlaba Ovamile. Sicela uzame futhi.

dex.title: amathokheni / USD

export.rangeHint: Igcina amazwibela nomsindo ekusikeni ngakunye. Ifayela ngalinye lifaka isiphetho semizuzwana engu-2.2 se-DeHub. Ukudawuniloda amafayela amaningi ndawonye NJENGE-ZIP.
export.archiveTooLarge: Ukudawuniloda kudlula u-512 MiB. Thumela iziqeshana ezimbalwa noma ukhethe isixazululo esiphansi.
export.gifHint: I-looping animation ngaphandle komsindo. Kuze kube yimizuzwana engu-60, amaphikseli angu-640 nama-fps angu-15. Kuhlanganisa ukuphela kwe-logo yakho.
export.gifTooLong: Nciphisa umugqa wesikhathi ube yimizuzwana engu-60 noma ngaphansi, noma ukhethe i-MP4 noma i-WebM.
export.title: Landa
export.videoDescription: Guqula umugqa wakho wesikhathi ube yifayela levidiyo.
export.unsupported: Isiphequluli sakho asikwazi ukukhipha ividiyo. Zama i-Chrome, i-Edge, i-Brave noma i-Arc, noma landa i-PNG noma i-JPG esikhundleni salokho.
export.cropMarkHint: Engeza izimpawu zokusika ngaphandle komsebenzi wobuciko. Ukulungiswa kokuphrinta okugciniwe kubeka usayizi wekhasi eliqediwe.
export.documentImageHint: Imininingwane ephezulu igcina izithombe zamakhasi amakhulu. Amafayela amancane anciphisa ubukhulu besithombe nekhwalithi ye-JPEG. Usayizi wekhasi nezixhumanisi kuyalondolozwa.
export.filenameHint: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze uthole amagama azenzakalelayo. Sebenzisa {title}, {name}, {section}, {page}, noma {page:3}. Engeza isiqalo njengombhalo ocacile. Amagama aphindwe kabili athola isijobelelo senombolo yekhasi.
export.jpegQualityHint: Ikhwalithi ephansi ngokuvamile ikhiqiza amafayela amancane. Ubukhulu be-pixel buhlala bufana; umsebenzi wobuciko onemininingwane ungase ubonise ukucindezelwa.
export.notesTextHint: Ilanda izihloko zesigaba, izinombolo zamakhasi zangempela, amagama amakhasi, namanothi omethuli njengefayela lombhalo.
export.pageOrderHint: Amakhasi alandela ukulandelana okufakiwe. Sebenzisa 3,1-2 ukuze uqale ngekhasi 3, noma 5-1 ukuze uhlehlise uhla. Izinombolo zamakhasi eziphindaphindiwe zivela kanye.
export.pptxHint: Ikhasi ngalinye liba isithombe sesilayidi esisodwa, esinamanothi omethuli nezixhumanisi. Hlela umbhalo ngamunye nezakhi kumklamo wokuqala.

agent.introBody: Chaza umklamo noma ushintsho ngamazwi akho. Ishintsha usayizi wekhasi, ibhale futhi ihlobise umbhalo, ithola izithombe, amavidiyo nomculo wamahhala, isebenzisa izihlungi, ihlele izendlalelo futhi izenze zinyakaze. Isicelo ngasinye sihlehliswa ngesinyathelo esisodwa.
agent.suggestPoster: Yenza okuthunyelwe kwe-Instagram okuyisikwele kokudayiswa kwasehlobo nesithombe solwandle nesihloko esigqamile
agent.suggestTitle: Engeza isihloko esikhulu esigqamile phezulu nesihlokwana esincane ngaphansi kwaso
agent.suggestFilter: Yenza isithombe sifudumale futhi sikhanye kancane
agent.suggestStory: Shintsha lokhu kube yi-story ye-9:16 bese ugcwalisa ikhasi ngesithombe
agent.suggestBackground: Engeza umculo ozolile wangemuva bese wenza umbhalo uvele kancane kancane
agent.nothingToDo: Angitholanga lutho lokushintsha. Zama ukuchaza ukuhlela okufunayo.
agent.rateLimited: Uthumele izicelo eziningi. Zama futhi emizuzwini embalwa.
agent.failed: I-AI ayikwazanga ukukwenza lokho manje. Zama futhi ngemuva kwesikhashana.

pages.label: Amakhasi
pages.allNotes: Wonke amakhasi angu-{{count}} efayeleni elilodwa lamanothi
pages.batchNameHint: Sebenzisa umugqa wokuqala wesihloko esikhulu kunazo zonke esibonakalayo ekhasini ngalinye. Amagama amakhasi akhona ayahlala ngaphandle uma ukhetha ukuwashintsha.
pages.durationBatchHint: Ukwelula kubamba isithombe esinganyakazi esifinyelela ekupheleni kwekhasi. Ukufinyeza kusika iziqeshana; amakhasi alandelayo ayashintsha. Imidiya igcina isivinini sayo sokudlala.
pages.layerDestinations: Izinombolo zamakhasi okuyiwa kuwo noma izinhla
pages.namedFromHeadings: Kuqanjwe amakhasi angu-{{count}}. Amakhasi angu-{{missing}} abengenaso isihloko.
pages.rangeHint: Sebenzisa izinombolo zamakhasi ezihlukaniswe ngo-comma, noma izinhla ezifana no-3-8.
pages.transferHint: Kopisha uye emakhasini afika kwangu-50, noma uye kwelilodwa. Amaqembu nendawo kulandela ukukhetha. Ukuthutha kuthinta leli khasi kuphela; okunye ukuvela kugcinwa. Indawo okuyiwa kuyo kufanele ihambisane nezendlalelo zesikhathi.
pages.transferLayers: Hambisa noma ukopishe izingqimba ezikhethiwe emakhasini
pages.visibilityHint: Amakhasi afihliwe ahlala elungiseka futhi ahlala etholakala ukuze udawunilode.

motion.title: Ukunyakaza
motion.hint: Amafreyimu ayisihluthulelo enza isendlalelo sinyakaze ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Engeza elilodwa lapha, hambisa ikhanda lokudlala, shintsha isendlalelo, sizoshelela phakathi kwawo.
motion.outside: Hambisa ikhanda lokudlala phezu kwalesi sendlalelo ukuze wengeze noma ushintshe amafreyimu ayisihluthulelo.
motion.curveHint: Hudula izibambo ukuze ubumbe ukuthi isendlalelo sihamba kanjani kusuka kule freyimu kuya kweelandelayo.
motion.noCurve: Beka ikhanda lokudlala efreyimini eyisihluthulelo ukuze ubumbe ijika layo.
motion.applyAll: Sebenzisa leli jika kuwo wonke amafreyimu ayisihluthulelo
motion.timelineKey: Ifreyimu eyisihluthulelo. Hudula ukuze uyihambise, chofoza kabili ukuze uyisuse.
motion.recordHint: Iyarekhoda: ukuhambisa, ukushintsha usayizi, ukuzungezisa noma ukufiphalisa isendlalelo ngaphansi kwekhanda lokudlala kwengeza amafreyimu ayisihluthulelo lapho.
motion.scrub: Hudula kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla ukuze ushintshe. Bamba u-Shift ukuze kushesha.

highlights.visualPrivacy: Thumela amafreyimu akhethiwe ukuze kuhlaziywe izithombe.
highlights.chatFound: Kutholakele {{count}} amakhansi. Buka-buka, qonda okukhethiwe, bese udale uhlobo lwehlelo oluhlukile.
highlights.chatHint: Ubuyekeza amakhansi. Bhala okufanele ukugcina noma ukususa, noma buya ekuhleleni.
highlights.chatSelectVideo: Khetha okukodwa okubonakala, okuvulekile kuvidiyo kuqala.
highlights.chatCaptionsMissing: Levidiyo ayinayo izichasi zamanje. Buza kabusha ngaphandle kokusetshenziswa kwezichasi zamanje ukuze uyihumusha.
highlights.chatLimit: Sebenzisa ividiyo elinganiselwe iminithi engu-10 kanye nebujethi bokukhanya bika-15, 30 noma 60 isigindi.
highlights.title: Amakhansi
highlights.privacy: Ividiyo ihlala kusixwayiso sakho. Umlando wezwi uhumusha lapha; umbhalo wumlando uthumelwa ukuze kulinganiswe amakhansi. Buyekeza umzuzwane ngamunye ngaphambi kokudala uhlobo lwehlelo oluhlukile.
highlights.captionHint: Kuphela ukukhuluma okulandelwe yizibikelo zamanje kuzocatshangelwa.
highlights.none: Akukho amakhukhula akhulumayo anolwazi atholakele. Zama isihloko esinye noma ividiyo esinye.
highlights.created: Uhlelo lokugqamisa lulondoloziwe. Umsebenzi wokuqala ugcinwe.
highlights.changed: Umsebenzi womthombo wabushintshi. Thola izigqamiso futhi.
highlights.limit: Sebenzisa kuze kube 10 iminithi yenkulumo yomthombo. Isikhwama esinde esihlanganisiwe kufanele sihlukaniswe kuqala.
highlights.reviewPlaceholder: Gcina kuphela amathiphu esikopele, noma susa umakhukhula 2…
highlights.reviewResult: Okukhethiwe {{count}} kuka {{total}} amakhukhula. Zibuyekeze ngaphambi kokudala uhlelo.
highlights.reviewFailed: Ayikwazanga okugunyaziswe okukhethwe. Izinketho zakho zangaphambilini zisazikhethile.

videoMatte.hint: Ibaleka kulesi sixhumi. Sika kuze kube {{seconds}} amasekhondi womthombo noma ngaphansi kuqala; ukuqala kwokuqala kufakela imodeli.

backgrounds.applyAll: Kopisha isizinda sekhasi kuwo wonke amakhasi
backgrounds.hint: Kopisha isithombe saleli khasi, i-gradient, noma isizinda esiqinile. Izizinda ezivaliwe zihlala zingashintshiwe.

brush.convertHint: Shintsha indlela engaphakathi ebhokisini layo lamanje ngesimo esingashintshwa. Isikhundla, usayizi, ukujikeleza, uhlu, imiphumela, ukuhlanganisa kanye nesikhathi kugcinwa. Imidwebo evulekile iba imigqa. Lungisa kabusha indlela edwetshiwe.
brush.pointHint: Ukwenza lula kususa ukuphambuka okuncane maqondana nebhokisi lomdwebo. Imidwebo evaliwe igcina okungenani amaphuzu amathathu. Izitayela zokushelela nokushaywa unhlangothi zisasebenza; lungisa kabusha amaphuzu okuqala.

bulk.connectionFileHint: Ukudlulisela umbhalo, i-QR, isithombe, ilinki nokuxhumeka kwenkundla yamakhasi ngamagama angqimba namakholomu. Ukuxhumana okufanayo kuthatha indawo yemephu yabo yamanje; amanye amabalazwe ahlala. Qamba izingqimba ezixhunyiwe ngendlela eyingqayizivele ngaphambi kokuthumela. Amarekhodi espredishithi nemidwebo yokuklama ayifakiwe.
bulk.connectionPlan: {{matched}} iyafana; {{layers}} izingqimba ezilahlekile, {{columns}} amakholomu alahlekile, {{ambiguous}} ukufana okungaqondakali kweqiwe
bulk.created: Isungulwe {{count}} amakhasi. Lungisa kabusha idizayini yasekuqaleni.
bulk.filterHint: Okufanayo akunaki i-case yezinhlamvu nezindawo ezizungezile. Izinombolo zokuqala zomugqa wespredishithi zigcinwa.
bulk.hint: Sebenzisa ikhasi lamanje njengesifanekiso. Xhuma izendlalelo zombhalo ne-QR kumakholomu espredishithi, noma faka amagama amakholomu kubakaki ababili ngaphakathi kombhalo wakho. Umugqa ngamunye okhethiwe udala ikhasi elisha; elokuqala lihlala endaweni yalo.
bulk.linksHint: Irekhodi ngalinye lingasetha izixhumanisi ezihlukene kumbhalo okopishiwe, izithombe, izithombe ezinyakazayo noma amavidiyo. Amanani axhunyiwe angenalutho asusa isixhumanisi. Izendlalelo ezikhiyiwe zigcina izixhumanisi zazo zesifanekiso.
bulk.matchHint: Ifanisa amagama aphelele ngenkathi iziba ukuhlukana phakathi kwezinhlamvu ezinkulu nezincane, izikhala eziphindaphindiwe, o-hyphen kanye no-underscore. Izixhumanisi ezisebenzayo ezikhona nezindawo zombhalo ziyagcinwa. Okufanayo okungacacile kuhlala kungaxhunyiwe. Izixhumanisi zezithombe zisebenzisa ukubheka isithombe esiqanjwe igama esikhona.
bulk.noText: Engeza isendlalelo sombhalo noma se-QR esingakhiyiwe kuleli khasi ukuze uxhume idatha yakho.
bulk.pageFieldsHint: Lawamakholomu angakhiqiza amakhasi ngisho ngaphandle kwezendlalelo zombhalo ezixhunyiwe. Amanothi nezigaba ezingenalutho kusula lezo zinkambu; eminye imidwebo ilandela isifanekiso.
bulk.pagePreviewHint: Ibonisa lokhu kurekhodi ngombhalo wamanje, ukuxhumana kwe-QR nesithombe esiqanjwe ngegama. Ukubuka kuqala akungezi amakhasi kumklamo wakho.
bulk.photosHint: Amanani ekholomu ahambisana namagama esendlalelo sesithombe somthombo kulo mklamo. Amanani angenalutho agcina isithombe sethempulethi noma ifreyimu. Ukubekwa nesitayela kulandela ithempulethi; isithombe somthombo ngasinye esiqanjwe ngegama kumele sitholakale kule divayisi.
bulk.title: Dala ngobuningi
bulk.tokenHint: Namathisela indawo yokubeka embhalweni wethempulethi noma kokuqukethwe kwe-QR bese ukhetha Sebenzisa izindawo zokubeka embhalweni kuleso sendlalelo. Ukufometha kushiya amanani espredishithi engashintshile. Amafomethi ezinombolo adinga izinombolo ezilula; u-25 ufomethwa njengo-25% kumodi yamaphesenti.

charts.areaModeHint: Izindawo ezinqwabelene nezinokulingana zibonisa uchungechunge ngalunye njengebhendi. Ama-streamgraph aphakathi nendawo azungeze uziro futhi afihle ithagethi yereferensi. Lezi zakhiwo zidinga amanani omthombo angewona amabi. Ukuboniswa okulinganiselayo kugcina izibalo zangempela kudatha; izindawo ezigqagqene zingafaka amanani amabi.
charts.benchmarkHint: Igcwalisa ithagethi engaguquki kuwo wonke amanani omthombo wamanje. Sebenzisa umugqa wethagethi ukuwusebenzisa; bala kabusha ngemva kokuhlela idatha.
charts.brandPaletteHint: Ilulayisha iphalethi elondoloziwe kuhlaka lwalolu shadi. Iphalethi elondoloziwe ligcina kufika emibhalweni eyishumi ehlukene yeshadi ezitayeleni zomkhiqizo. Amanani eshadi ahlala engashintshile.
charts.bubbleColumnHint: Izixhumanisi ze-X zihlala kukholomu yokuqala. Ikholomu ye-Y ekhethiwe kuphela ethinta isikali esime mpo. Ikholomu yosayizi idinga amanani angewona amabi anenani elilodwa okungenani eliyisakhayo; osayizi abalinganayo basebenzisa izisindo zeyunithi. Ukuhlela kabusha amakholomu kugcina lezi zindima nedatha yazo.
charts.bubbleHint: Sebenzisa izixhumanisi ze-X zezinombolo kukholomu yokuqala. Kumodi yochungechunge oluningi, khetha amakholomu e-Y nawosayizi ngezansi; okuzenzakalelayo kusebenzisa uchungechunge lokuqala lwe-Y nolwesibili losayizi. Izindawo zilingana nosayizi; osayizi abanguziro bayafihlwa. Ngaphandle kochungechunge losayizi, amabhamuza ayalingana. Uchungechunge olwengeziwe luhlala kudatha yomthombo. Amalebula amanani abonisa u-Y / usayizi. Ama-eksisi nesikali kungasebenzisa izinsuku nezikhathi ze-UTC ze-X.
charts.bubbleSingleColumn: Vumela uchungechunge lwedatha oluningi ukuthi lukhethe amakholomu e-Y nosayizi ahlukene. Idatha yochungechunge olulodwa isebenzisa osayizi bamabhamuza alinganayo.
charts.categoryAxisHint: Gcina yonke indawo yedatha ngenkathi ubeka amalebula ayo ngokuhlukana. Izigaba zokuqala nezokugcina zihlala zinelebula. Amalebula atshekile asebenzisa umugqa owodwa; buyela ku-0° ukuze usebenzise ukusonga.
charts.categorySummaryHint: Lonke uchungechunge lufingqwa ngokwehlukana. Izigaba zigcina igama lazo lokuqala, indawo kanye nombala wesigaba. Isibalo semigqa sibala imigqa yomthombo efanayo kuwo wonke uchungechunge. Sebenzisa okuthi Hlehlisa ushintsho lwedrafti ukuze ubuyisele imigqa yokuqala.
charts.dateAxisHint: Sebenzisa amadethi e-ISO (2026-01-31) noma izitempu zesikhathi ze-UTC (2026-01-31T14:30Z) kukholomu yokuqala yedatha. Izikhundla zibonisa isikhathi esidlulile, okuhlanganisa nezikhala. Amalebula amadethi nesikhathi asebenzisa i-UTC kuwo wonke amadivayisi. Imingcele yandisa isikali ngenkathi igcina yonke idatha ibonakala.
charts.donutTotalHint: Isamba sifingqa izingxenye ezinhle futhi sisebenzisa ifomethi yenani ekhethiwe.
charts.filterHint: Izimo ezintathu ezisebenzayo kumele zifane zonke. Ukuhlunga kushintsha ishadi elibonisiwe kanye nokuthunyelwa kwezithombe kuyilapho kugcinwa wonke umugqa womthombo. Izihlungi zochungechunge eziqanjwe ngamagama ziyazitshwa uma lolo chungechunge lususwa noma luqanjwa kabusha. Izithombe zenqubekelaphambili zigcina inani lazo lokuqala lomthombo.
charts.funnelHint: Izigaba zilandela ukulandelana kwemigqa. Sebenzisa amanani angeyona imbi anesigaba esisodwa esihle okungenani. Imibala yezigaba, amalebula kanye namanani ahlelwa ngokwehlukana.
charts.hierarchyImportHint: Namathisela idatha ye-CSV noma ehlukaniswe ngethebhu enezikholamu zesigaba eziyisithupha kanye nekholamu yosayizi wenombolo yokugcina. Imigqa engafika kwengama-50 iba yizindlela zokuhleleka ezihlukaniswe ngemivimbo. Amaseli esigaba kumele agcwaliswe futhi awakwazi ukuba no-/. Lokhu kuthatha indawo yedatha esalungiswa ngochungechunge olulodwa.
charts.histogramFormatHint: Ifomethi yokubonisa inombolo imisa imingcele yesikhala; amafrikhwensi ahlala njengezibalo. Amaqoqo edatha amancane noma afanayo asebenzisa izikhala ezimbalwa. Umngcele ongaphezulu ungowesikhala sokugcina.
charts.intervalsHint: Izikhawu eziningi zinikeza amalebula esikali acace kakhudlwana; ezimbalwa zenza isakhiwo esihlanzekile. Amashadi okusabalalisa (scatter) namashadi amabhamuza angalungisa izikali ezivundlile neziqondile ngokuzimela.
charts.markerHint: Izimo namaphethini emigqa kunikeza enye indlela yokuhlukanisa uchungechunge. Okhiye bezincazelo balandela isakhiwo. Usayizi wephoyinti ongu-zero ufihla omaka; osayizi bamabhamuza bagcina isikali sawo sendawo eyindilinga.
charts.missingFilterSeries: Izihlungi {{filters}} zikhomba uchungechunge olushodayo noma olungacacile futhi okwamanje azinakiwe.
charts.noBrandPalettes: Londoloza iphalethi yombala ezitayeleni ze-Brand ukuze uyisebenzise lapha.
charts.noTypes: Azikho izinhlobo zamashadi ezifanayo. Zama okunye okuseshiwe noma iqembu.
charts.observationHint: Namathisela izinombolo ezifika ku-50 ezihlukaniswe ngokukhefana, amathebhu noma ukweqiwa kolayini. Lokhu kuthatha indawo yedatha esalungiswa ngolunye uchungechunge. Okubhekwayo kwasekuqaleni kuhlala kumaseli naku-CSV yomthombo; amabhini e-histogram abalwa ukuze aboniswe.
charts.orderHint: Amanani kulo lonke uchungechunge ahamba nezigaba zawo. Imibala yezigaba zochungechunge olulodwa ilandela ukulandelana okufanayo.
charts.percentHint: Faka amaphuzu amaphesenti: inani elingu-25 liboniswa njengo-25%.
charts.percentStackHint: Isigaba ngasinye sibonisa izabelo zamaphesenti. Amanani amahle namabi ngalinye lihlanganisa u-100% ohlangothini lwawo lwe-zero. Amanani omthombo ahlala kugridi yedatha nasekulandweni kwe-CSV.
charts.pictogramRounding: Izimpawu zilinganisa isabelo ngasinye kusetshenziswa ama-ayikhoni aphelele. Izabelo ezincane zingazungeziswa zibe u-zero; incazelo igcina amanani omthombo. Khulisa inani lezimpawu ukuze uthole imininingwane ecace kakhudlwana. Inani le-ayikhoni alithathi indawo yedatha yakho.
charts.pieValueHint: Nika amandla u-Show values ukuze ubonise le fomethi. Izabelo zisebenzisa izingcezu ezinhle kuphela; inani eliphakathi nendawo ligcina ifomethi yalo yenani.
charts.progressColours: Umbala wephalethi wokuqala ugcwalisa inqubekelaphambili; owesibili ubonisa umzila osele. I-Show values ilawula ilebula yamaphesenti. Lawa mashadi asebenzisa inani lomthombo wokuqala kuphela.
charts.raceAnimate: Gqwayisa kuso sonke isikhathi somugqa wesikhathi sesithombe
charts.raceHint: Sebenzisa idatha yochungechunge oluningi ngezigaba kukholomu yokuqala. Amakholomu amabili kuya kwayisithupha alandelayo amafreyimu alandelanayo; amagama awo avela njengezincazelo zefreyimu. Izindinganiso kumelwe zingabi ezingezinhle. Izigaba zigcina imibala yazo njengoba izilinganiso zishintsha. Ukudlala kudlulisela isikhathi sesikhathi sesithombe.
charts.racePosterHint: Ifreyimu esaqhubeka ilawula i-SVG nokubuka kuqala okusalungiswa. Vala i-animation ukuze ufake lelo freyimu emgqeni wesikhathi futhi. Ukuthunyelwa kwe-animated raster nevidiyo kusebenzisa isikhathi sokudlala. Wonke amafreyimu abelana ngesikali esiphezulu esinqunyiwe.
charts.referenceHint: Umgomo wandisa isikali senani uma kudingeka. Imigomo enamaphesenti asebenzisa amaphesenti amaphuzu; eminye imigomo isebenzisa amayunithi omthombo.

scale.hint: Imingcele yandisa isikali esizenzakalelayo ukuze amashadi ahlobene akwazi ukuhlanganyela uhla. Izindinganiso ezingaphandle kwaleyo mikhawulo zihlala zibonakala.

charts.scatterHint: Izindawo zokuhlakaza zisebenzisa izixhumanisi zezinombolo ze-X kukholomu yokuqala namanani ka-Y kumakholomu asele. Uchungechunge oluningi lwabelana ngalezo zixhumanisi ze-X. Khetha Izinsuku nezikhathi ze-UTC kuma-Axes bese ulinganisa i-axis evundlile yesikhathi esidlule.
charts.scatterLinesHint: Imigqa ilandela ukulandelana komugqa. Hlunga ngo-X wezinombolo kuDatha ukuze uxhume amaphuzu ukusuka kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla. Uchungechunge olulodwa lusebenzisa umbala walo wokuqala wephalethi kulayini.
charts.seriesStructureHint: Izindinganiso nemibala kulandela uchungechunge ngalunye. Uchungechunge olusha luqala ngo-zero. Qamba kabusha uchungechunge emgqeni wokuqala wegridi yedatha.
charts.starterHint: Isiqalo sithatha indawo yohlobo lwedatha, idatha, nokufometha kwalolu hlaka. Ikhanvasi yakho yamanje ishintsha kuphela uma ubuyekeza noma ufaka isithombe.
charts.styleFileHint: Idlulisa ukubukeka namaphalethi phakathi kwamadivayisi. Idatha yeshadi, uhlobo, izihloko, umbhalo ophakathi nendawo, nemingcele yesikali kuhlala kuklamo okuyiwa kulo.
charts.styleKeepsData: Izitayela zigcina uhlobo lwakho lweshadi, idatha, ifomethi yezinombolo, imingcele yesikali, nombhalo ophakathi nendawo.
charts.transposeHint: Izigaba ezifika kweziyisithupha ziba uchungechunge. Uchungechunge olukhona luba yizigaba; ukulandelana kwephalethi kuhlala kungashintshile.
charts.transposeScatter: Shintshela eshadini lesigaba ukuze uguqule idatha.
charts.treemapHint: Sebenzisa izindlela eziyingqayizivele zamaqabunga ezifana ne-Europe / France ne-Europe / Germany. Kusekelwa amazinga afika kwayisithupha. Amanani kumele abe ngaphezu kuka-zero, okungenani ngenani elilodwa elihle. Amanani angu-zero ayafihlwa. Indlela ayikwazi ukuba yiqembu kanye neqabunga ngesikhathi esisodwa. Uchungechunge lokuqala luhlinzeka ngamanani; olunye uchungechunge lomthombo luyagcinwa.
charts.typeDraftHint: Ukushintsha uhlobo kugcina idatha yakho yohlaka. Buyekeza noma ufake isithombe uma usukulungele.

clipboard.empty: Khetha izingqimba zangaphambili ezingakhiyiwe kuleli khasi

colourPicker.failed: Kuhlulekile ukufunda umbala wekhanvasi. Zama futhi noma ufake inani lombala.

compositions.brandFontHint: Isebenzisa amafonti esihloko nomzimba alondoloziwe kuhlanganiso olusha. Imibala yombhalo neyokugqamisa isebenzisa izilawuli ezingenhla; imidwebo ekhona ihlala ezindaweni zayo.
compositions.changed: Idizayini ishintshile ngaphambi kokuba lokhu kubhangqwa kufakwe.
compositions.heading: Isihloko
compositions.layoutFontsActive: Isakhiwo ngasinye sisebenzisa ukubhangqwa kwaso kwamafonti kwasekuqaleni.
compositions.limit: Lokhu kubhangqwa kweqa imikhawulo yezingqimba noma yosayizi wedizayini.
compositions.noSavedFonts: Londoloza ifonti yesihloko noma yomzimba ezitayeleni ze-Brand ukuze uyisebenzise lapha.
compositions.previewHint: Buka kuqala ngombala wekhasi, ngaphandle kweminye imidwebo. Faka ukubhangqwa okukhethiwe ukuze ungeze izingqimba ezihlelekayo.
compositions.previewNeedsData: Faka isihloko nemibala ephelele ukuze ubuke kuqala lokhu kubhangqwa.
compositions.previewUnavailable: Ukubuka kuqala kukhanvasi akutholakali. Okusalungiswa kwakho kuseyikho okuhlelekayo.

connectors.title: Imigqa nezixhumi

crop.canvasHint: Hudula ukuze uhambise isithombe ngaphakathi kohlaka lwaso.
crop.focusHint: Hambisa iwindi lokunqampuna ngenkathi ugcina usayizi walo.
crop.precisionHint: Izilinganiso zishintsha ukunqampuna ngenkathi kulondolozwa indawo ebonisiwe. Izindawo zokugxila zihambisa iwindi lokunqampuna elikhona phakathi kwemingcele yalo etholakalayo, okuhlanganisa nezithombe ezijikisiwe.

dataCells.actionRange: Ibanga lamaseli (lishiye lingenalutho kuwo wonke amaseli)
dataCells.invalidAddress: Khetha iseli ekhona phakathi kuka-A1 no-{{last}}
dataCells.keyboardHint: I-Tab ihambisa kumaseli; u-Enter uhambisa phansi. Namathisela amaseli espredishithi ngqo kugridi.
dataCells.numberCleanupHint: Ukuhlanzwa kwezinombolo kususa izimpawu zemali ezisekelwayo kanye nezihlukanisi zamaqoqo, futhi kuguqula izinombolo ezingezinhle zokubalwa kwezimali. Amaphesenti ahlala engamaphesenti: u-25% uba ngu-25. Umbhalo ongaqashelwa uhlala unjalo. Izenzo zihlela amaseli omthombo ngenkathi kugcinwa ukufomethwa kwetafula kuxhunywe ezindaweni zamaseli.
dataCells.pasteHint: Namathisela imigqa evela kuspredishithi, i-CSV, noma i-TSV. Athatha indawo yohla olungunxande oluqala kuseli ekhethiwe; idatha ezungezile iyagcinwa.
dataCells.valueHint: Hlela iseli lonke lapha, kuhlanganise nokwephuka komugqa. Amanani agcinwa njengombhalo; amafomula awabalwa.

Izincazelo ze-SVG zihambisana nokuthunyelwa kwe-vector; ezinye izindlela zokuthumela zigcina umbhalo obonakalayo. Chaza okutholiwe okuyinhloko namanani afanele kumbhalo ohlukile.
dataVisual.expandedHint: Izinguquko zihlala kuso leso sifanekiso esiseceleni. Vala lo mhleli, bese ubuyekeza noma ufake isithombe ukuze uzisebenzise kukhanvasi.
dataVisual.fixSource: Sebenzisa idatha yomthombo ukulungisa lokhu okufakiwe.
dataVisual.previewAlt: Ukubuka kuqala kweshadi noma ithebula elisayilungiswa
dataVisual.previewHint: Ukubuka kuqala okusalungiswa kumbala wekhasi. Sebenzisa isithombe ukuze ulondoloze lezi zinguquko.
dataVisual.previewNeedsData: Faka idatha nemibala evumelekile ukuze ubuke kuqala isithombe.
dataVisual.previewUnavailable: Ukubuka kuqala kukhanvasi akutholakali. Okusalungiswa kwakho kusengahleleka.
dataVisual.singleSeriesViewHint: Leli shadi libonisa uhlu lokuqala lwedatha; ezinye izinhlu zisalokhu zikwimithombo.
dataVisual.title: Amashadi namathebula

designTools.colourHint: Khetha umbala ozowushintsha kulo lonke lolu hlelo. Izendlalelo ezikhiyiwe ziyagcinwa.

diagrams.editHint: I-node ngayinye nombhalo wayo kwakha iqembu. Amalebula okuxhuma ahlanganiswe ngemigqa yawo. Imigqa ihlala izixhumi ezihlukile ezilungisekayo; zibeke kabusha ngemva kokuhambisa ama-node. Amalebula angenalutho asebenzisa umbhalo wokuqalisa. Umdwebo ugcwalisa ubude bekhasi lamanje futhi ungagcinwa kulabhulali yakho yezinto ezingasetshenziswa kabusha.
diagrams.previewHint: Buka kuqala usebenzisa umbala wekhasi ngaphandle komunye umsebenzi wobuciko. Faka umdwebo ukuze ufake izingqimba ezilungisekayo.
diagrams.previewNeedsData: Qedela imibala bese usebenzisa amalebula e-node afinyelela ezinhlamvwini ezingu-120 ukuze ubuke kuqala.
diagrams.previewUnavailable: Ukubuka kusengaphambili kwe-canvas akutholakali. Okusalungiswayo kuhlala kungahlelwa.
diagrams.title: Iziqalo zomdwebo ezilungisekayo

document.numberHint: Faka izinombolo zekhasi ezilungisekayo kuyo yonke idokhumenti. Ukubuyekezwa kwezinombolo lapho amakhasi efakwa, ephindwe kabili, esuswa, noma ehlelwa kabusha. Izinombolo ezikhiyiwe zihlala zingashintshiwe.
document.repeatHint: Khetha inhloko, unyawo, ilogo, noma umsebenzi wobuciko omiyo ukuze uwukopishe endaweni efanayo emakhasini akhethiwe. Ikhophi ngayinye ihlala ihleleka ngokuzimela.
document.repeatScopeHint: Isebenzisa izinombolo zamakhasi edokhumenti. Ikhasi lamanje lihlale likhishiwe.
document.title: Izinombolo zamakhasi nezakhi eziphindwayo

fills.hint: Sebenzisa i-gradient kumbhalo okhethiwe noma izimo, noma uyengeze ngemuva kwaleli khasi.

fonts.graphicCoverage: Kuhlanganisa izendlalelo zombhalo, amashadi namathebula. Izendlalelo ezikhiyiwe zigcina amafonti azo.
fonts.replaceDesign: Shintsha ifonti kulo lonke lolu hlelo

gradients.brandPaletteHint: Ilulayisha imibala yephalethi kuhlaka lwe-gradient ngezindawo zokumisa ezingabonakali, ezihlukaniswe ngokulinganayo. Ama-gradient asebenzisa imibala efinyelela kwesishiyagalombili; amaphalethi amakhulu agcina iziphetho zawo futhi akhethe imibala ephakathi kwawo.
gradients.invalid: Sebenzisa imibala ye-hex enamadijithi ayisithupha ephelele kuyo yonke indawo yokumisa.
gradients.noBrandPalettes: Londoloza iphalethi enemibala okungenani emibili ezitayeleni ze-Brand ukuze uyisebenzise lapha.
gradients.styleFileHint: Idlulisa imibala ye-gradient, izikhundla, ukukhanya, i-angle nezilungiselelo ze-radial phakathi kwamadivayisi. Ukungenisa kulayisha uhlaka; kulusebenzise ukuze ubuyekeze umsebenzi wobuciko.
gradients.svgHint: Ithumela le-gradient ngosayizi wekhasi, okuhlanganisa izikhundla zezindawo zokumisa nokukhanya. Yisebenzise ngokuhlukile ukuze uyisebenzise ekwakhiweni.

grids.hint: Faka isakhiwo sesithombe, bese uphonsa izithombe ezinhlakeni zaso. Chofoza kabili uhlaka ukuze uluhlele ngaphakathi kweqembu.
grids.title: Amagridi ezithombe

groups.matchSizeHint: Ilinganisela ingqimba ngayinye noma iqembu ngokuzungeza isikhungo saso futhi igcine izilinganiso. Izilinganiso zifaka nokujikeleza. Ibhokisi lesethenjwa elilinganiselwe lisebenzisa usayizi omkhulu kakhulu olingana nobukhulu bobubili; okukhulu kakhulu nokuncane kakhulu kuqhathanisa indawo yebhokisi lale nketho. Izitayela zombhalo nemivimbo ziyalinganisela kanye nomsebenzi wobuciko.

mockups.caption: Ikheli noma amazwibela esithombe (uyazikhethela)
mockups.editHint: Ifaka iqoqo lezimo ezihlelekayo kanye nozimele wesithombe waleli khasi. Isithombe esikopishiwe sigcina imiphumela yaso kanye nephuzu eliyinhloko elinokugcwalisa isikrini, noma sigcina ukunqampuna kwaso kwamanje ngokulinganisa isithombe. Isithombe sokuqala sihlala endaweni yaso. Khetha isikrini ukuze ushintshe isithombe saso; hlukanisa iqoqo ukuze uhlele imininingwane yozimele ngamunye.
mockups.emptyScreen: Khetha isithombe esisodwa esingakhiyiwe ukuze ugcwalise i-mockup, noma ufake isikrini esingenalutho bese usishintsha kamuva.
mockups.fitHint: Gcwalisa isikrini kunqampuna kuze kufike ozimele. Ukulinganisa isithombe kugcina ukunqampuna kwesithombe esikhethiwe kwamanje futhi kukhombisa isizinda sesikrini esisizungezile.
mockups.noPalettes: Londoloza iphalethi ezitayeleni ze-Brand ukuze uyisebenzise lapha.
mockups.paletteHint: Imibala emithathu yokuqala ibeka okokwakha ifreyimu, imininingwane kanye nesizinda sesikrini. Imibala engekho igcina amanani ayo amanje. I-Save palette igcina le mibala yefreyimu ezitayeleni ze-Brand.
mockups.placementHint: Yonke i-mockup ijikeleza ndawonye futhi ilingana ngaphakathi kwaleli phesenti lekhasi. Izimo zayo, isithombe kanye nombhalo osezansi kuhlala kuhleleka njengeqembu.
mockups.previewHint: Ukubuka kuqala kukhombisa i-mockup ngaphandle kweminye imidwebo. Ukuyifaka kwengeza izingqimba ezihlelekayo ekhasini lamanje.
mockups.previewNeedsData: Qedela imibala yefreyimu ukuze ubuke kuqala.
mockups.previewUnavailable: Ukubuka kuqala akutholakali. Izilungiselelo zefreyimu zihlala zihleleka.
mockups.title: Ama-mockup wedivayisi nawokuphrinta

pageAnimation.title: Khanyisa ikhasi
pageAnimation.typewriterHint: Umbhalo uyathayipha; ezinye izendlalelo ziyaphela. Ubude besikhathi bungena ngaphakathi kwesikhathi sesendlalelo ngasinye.

palette.chooseTarget: Khetha umbala wedokhumenti kuqala ukuze usebenzise isampula njengomthombo wokushintsha.
palette.extractionHint: Ithatha amasampula ekhasini lamanje, kuhlanganise nezithombe. Khetha isampula njengombala ozoshintsha, noma usebenzise iphalethi emibaleni engahleleka kulo lonke umklamo.
palette.presetLimit: Izikhala zakho ezingama-20 zesitayela somkhiqizo zigcwele. Susa isitayela esilondoloziwe ngaphambi kokungeza iphalethi.

photoBackground.hint: Khetha isithombe ozosisebenzisa ngemuva kwaleli khasi. Chofoza kabili ingemuva ukuze ulilungise kabusha, noma ulikhiphe njengesendlalelo esinyakazayo.
photoBackground.unavailable: Isithombe asikwazanga ukushintshwa. Hlola izizinda ezikhiyiwe kanye nomkhawulo wezendlalelo zomklamo.

photoLooks.batchHint: Sebenzisa ezithombeni namavidiyo akhethiwe angu-{{count}} ngokuhlela okukodwa. Ukulondoloza kusebenzisa izinguquko zesendlalelo sokuqala esikhethiwe.
photoLooks.hint: Kulondolozwe nge-akhawunti ngayinye kule divayisi. Ukusebenzisa ukubukeka kushintsha izinguquko zombala, ukufiphala kanye nemininingwane. Ukunqampuna, ozimele, imingcele nesikhathi kuhlala ezindaweni zako. Ngenisa ukubukeka ukuze ukusebenzise, bese ukulondoloza kulabhulali yakho.
photoLooks.memoryOnly: Kutholakala kulesi sikhathi sokusebenzisa; isitoreji sedivayisi asikwazanga ukukulondoloza
photoLooks.name: Igama lokubukeka
photoLooks.saved: Ilabhulali yokubukeka kwezithombe ibuyekeziwe kule divayisi
photoLooks.styleFileHint: Idlulisa izinguquko zombala, ukufiphala, i-duotone kanye nemininingwane phakathi kwamadivayisi. Ukungenisa kukhombisa igama laso elilondoloziwe; sikusebenzise ukuze ushintshe izinguquko zemidiya ekhethiwe. Ukunqampuna, ozimele, imingcele nesikhathi kuhlala ezindaweni zako.
photoLooks.title: Ukubukeka kwezithombe okulondoloziwe

photos.arrangeHint: Ozimele, izikhundla, isitayela, namaqembu kuhlala ezindaweni zawo. Izindawo okugxilwe kuzo ezithombeni zilandela imithombo yazo. Izizinda nezithombe ezithatha amakhasi amaningi azifakiwe.
photos.narrowSearch: Kukhonjiswa ozimele bokuqala abayi-100 abafanayo. Sesha ukuze unciphise uhlu.
photos.needFrames: Engeza okungenani izithombe ezimbili ezingakhiyiwe kuleli khasi ukuze uzihlele kabusha.
photos.searchFrames: Thola uzimele wesithombe ngegama noma ngenombolo

present.allHidden: Wonke amakhasi afihliwe. Kukhonjiswa ikhasi lokuqala lalesi sethulo.
present.nextPreviewHint: Ukubuka kuqala kuphela. Sebenzisa Okulandelayo ukuze uye kuleli khasi.
present.rehearsalHint: Ukuvakashela kuqoqeka ngekhasi ngalinye. Isikhathi siyama ngenkathi uhlelo lokusebenza lungemuva, amakhasi elayisha, noma isikhethi sekhasi sivuliwe. Misa isikhashana ngaphambi kokusebenzisa; ubude besikhathi samakhasi angakavakashelwa buhlala bungashintshile.
present.title: Yethula amakhasi

qr.brandPaletteHint: Ikhetha ingaphambili elimnyama nengemuva elikhanyayo kusuka kuphalethi, isebenzisa okumnyama noma okumhlophe lapho kudingeka umehluko omkhulu. Iphalethi elondoloziwe igcina imibala yamanje ye-QR; okuqukethwe okubethelwe kuhlala kungashintshile.
qr.calendarHint: Izenzakalo ezinesikhathi zisebenzisa i-UTC; ama-app ekhalenda awabonise endaweni yesikhathi somamukeli. Izinsuku zonke zihlanganisa usuku lokugcina. Ukusekela kweskena kuyehluka; ifayela lekhalenda lingafakwa ngokuqondile.
qr.contactHint: Yakha ukuthintana kwe-VCard. Ukuskena kunganikeza ukulondoloza le mininingwane; ukuziphatha kuxhomeke kuskena.
qr.downloadCalendarHint: Gcina umcimbi ofanayo njengefayela lekhalenda elingeniswayo.
qr.downloadContactHint: Gcina imininingwane efanayo yokuxhumana njengefayela lencwadi yakho yekheli.
qr.failed: Sebenzisa umbhalo omfushane nemibala emibili ehlukene ye-hex.
qr.hint: Yakha ikhodi ye-QR yelinki noma yombhalo. Gcina umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwesizinda sangaphambili nesangemuva.
qr.noBrandPalettes: Londoloza iphalethi yombala ngezitayela zeBrand ukuze uyisebenzise lapha.
qr.smsHint: Ivula okusalungiswa kwemiyalezo kumadivayisi asekelwayo. Usizo lomamukeli nolwenziwe ngaphambilini lwemiyalezo luxhomeke ku-app.
qr.title: Ikhodi ye-QR
qr.vectorHint: Ithumela ngaphandle okusalungiswa kwe-QR kwamanje ngemibala yayo nendawo ethule njengomsebenzi wobuciko we-vector ongalungiseka.
qr.wifiContentHint: Okuqukethwe kwe-QR okwenziwe kuqukethe iphasiwedi yenethiwekhi.

repeat.gapsFitted: Izikhala zilungiswe ukuze zihambisane nemingcele yekhasi. Dala igridi ukuze uyisebenzise.
repeat.groupCopiesHint: Iqoqa zonke izendlalelo ezikopishiwe ngaphakathi kwethayela ngalinye. Ukukhetha kwasekuqaleni kugcina amaqoqo akho.
repeat.hint: Khetha umbhalo, izithombe, izimo, noma umklamo oqoqiwe. Yiphindaphinde ngakwesokudla naphansi ukusuka endaweni yayo yamanje. Okokuqala kuyiseli yegridi yokuqala; amakhophi agcina isitayela sawo, ukunqampuna, nokunyakaza.
repeat.staggerHint: Izakhiwo ezishintshanayo zishintsha njalo umugqa wesibili noma ikholomu ngesigamu seseli, kuhlanganise nesikhala sayo. Okokuqala kuhlala endaweni yakhona.
repeat.title: Phinda ukukhetha kugridi

resize.printHint: Ukulungiswa kokuphrinta kubeka usayizi wekhasi eliphathekayo ekulandweni kwe-PDF. Izilinganiso ezikhona zikala nge-canvas.
resize.range: Uhlangothi ngalunye kumele lube phakathi kwama-64–8,192 amaphikseli. Ukulungiswa kokuphrinta kumele kube ngu-72–600.

sections.hint: Izigaba zihamba namakhasi lapho ehlelwa kabusha noma ekopishwa. Zithole ekusesheni ikhasi, ekuphequluleni isethulo, nasezinhlelweni zamagama efayela lesithombe angu-{section}.
sections.name: Igama lesigaba
sections.title: Hlela amakhasi akhethiwe abe yizigaba

selection.boundHint: Kukalwe kusuka emingceleni yokukhetha ejikelezisiwe. Ukushintsha usayizi kugcina izilinganiso; isikhundla siqala ekhoneni eliphezulu kwesobunxele lekhasi.
selection.mixedStyles: Izendlalelo ezikhethiwe zinezitayela ezixubile. Ukusebenzisa inani kulisetha kuzo zonke izingqimba ezihambisanayo.
selection.sameHint: Qhathanisa ungqimba lokuqala olukhethiwe kuleli khasi. Amaqembu ahlala ndawonye; izingqimba ezifihliwe, izizinda, namaqembu akhiyiwe kuyeqiwa.
selection.waitForBounds: Lindela izingqimba ezikhethiwe ukuba zivele ku-canvas.

selectionShadows.hint: Kusebenza emidwebweni engaphambili ekhethiwe ekuhleleni okukodwa. Ukufiphala nokungafinyeleli kusebenzisa isikali sereferensi somhleli esingu-1080p.

svgPath.hint: Namathisela idatha yomzila d noma uphawu oluyisisekelo lwe-SVG olunemizila, unxande, imibuthano, ama-ellipses, imigqa namapholigoni. Imiyalo yokuhambisa, yomugqa, ye-cubic, ye-quadratic, ebushelelezi neye-arc iyasekelwa. I-SVG matrix, ukuhumusha, ukukala, ukujikeleza nokuguqula i-skew kugcina i-geometry yayo. I-geometry isebenzisa umbala oyikhethile; upende wasekuqaleni, unhlangothi kanye nemingcele yokubuka akungeniswa. Amajika aba amasampula ezindawo zokudweba. Vala indlela ngo-Z ukuze uyigcwalise. Izakhi ezihlukene ze-SVG ezivaliwe zingagcwaliswa ndawonye. Izingxenye eziningi ziba izingqimba ezilungisekayo eziqoqiwe; izimbobo eziyinhlanganisela azisekelwa.
svgPath.name: Igama lesendlalelo
svgPath.title: Ngenisa i-geometry ye-SVG ekwazi ukuhlela

symbols.hint: Izimpawu zihlala zikwazi ukulungiswa. Phinda ufake umbala, ushintshe usayizi, ujikeleze, uhlanganise, noma ufake imiphumela usebenzisa izilawuli zesendlalelo.
symbols.noResults: Azikho izimpawu ezihambisanayo. Zama elinye igama noma isigaba.

symbols.vectorDownloadHint: Ithumela uphawu lomtapo wolwazi ngombala okhethiwe nobukhulu bomugqa kusizinda esisobala.

tables.brandPaletteHint: Isebenzisa umbala wephalethi ogciniwe wokuqala kwekhanda, nemingcele ehambisanayo, imivimbo ecashile kanye nombhalo omnyama noma omhlophe ozenzakalelayo. Ukugcwaliswa komzimba nezitayela zamaseli ezenziwe ngokwezifiso kuhlala ezindaweni zako. Iphalethi yokulondoloza igcina imibala yethebula yamanje.
tables.cellStyleHint: Faka iseli noma ibanga ukuze ubeke ngaphezu kwetimu yethebula. Setha kabusha amaseli ukuze ubuyisele ukubukeka okuzenzakalelayo kwethebula.

find.hint: Ukushintsha nokuhlanza kusebenzisa uhla olukhethiwe, noma wonke amaseli uma engenalutho, kuyilapho kugcinwa ukufomethwa kweseli. Buyekeza isithombe ukuze usebenzise okusalungiswa; Hlehlisa kubuyisela ukuhlela okusetshenzisiwe.

tables.fitColumnsHint: Ububanzi bulandela umbhalo weseli ongahlanganisiwe njengoba idatha ishintsha, ngaphakathi kwemingcele elinganiselayo. Ithebula ligcina usayizi walo uwonke. Ukulinganisa ikholomu ngesandla kuyakucisha lokhu.
tables.fitRowsHint: Imigqa yabelana ngokuphakama kwethebula ngokombhalo wayo, ukugcwalisa nokusonga. Amaseli ahlanganisa imigqa eminingi awuthinti usayizi. Ukulinganisa umugqa ngesandla kuyakucisha lokhu.
tables.fitTextHint: Iseli ngalinye lingancipha liye ku-35% wusayizi wombhalo okhethiwe. Umbhalo usasebenzisa amachashazi amathathu uma ungalingani; ukusonga kusekela imigqa efika kwesishiyagalombili.
tables.mergeHint: Amaseli ahlanganisiwe akhombisa iseli eliphezulu kwesobunxele. Okuqukethwe kumaseli amboziwe kuyagcinwa futhi kuphinde kuvele uma kuhlanganiswe kabusha.
tables.noBrandPalettes: Londoloza iphalethi yombala ngezitayela zeBrand ukuze uyisebenzise lapha.
tables.replaceOverrides: Setha kabusha izitayela zamaseli aqokiwe lapho ufaka isicelo
tables.rowCleanup: Susa imigqa engenalutho noma ephindwe kabili
tables.rowCleanupHint: Umugqa wesihloko ugcinwa. Ukuhlanza okuphindaphindiwe kugcina umugqa wokuqala ofanayo futhi kulondoloza izitayela zamaseli ezisele nosayizi womugqa. Umbhalo uqhathaniswa ngaphandle kokuwushintsha. Amatafula agcina okungenani umugqa owodwa; amangqamuzana angahlanganisiwe anemigqa ngaphambi kokuhlanza.
tables.scaleHint: Faka imibala yamangqamuzana ezinombolo ebangeni elikhethiwe. Amaseli angenalutho, athumelelana imiyalezo namaseli ahlanganisiwe agcina izitayela zawo. Faka isicelo futhi ngemva kokushintsha izinombolo.
tables.starterHint: Isiqalo sithatha indawo yale datha yetafula lokusungula nokufometha. Ikhanva yakho yamanje iyashintsha kuphela uma ubuyekeza noma ufaka isithombe. Isibonelo samanani nengqikithi yizindinganiso ezilungisekayo; azibalwa kabusha ngokuzenzakalelayo.
tables.structureHint: Ukufometha amaseli nosayizi ohlobene kulandela imigqa namakholomu awo. Izihloko zihlala emgqeni wokuqala noma kukholomu.
tables.styleFileHint: Ukudlulisela ukubukeka namaphalethi phakathi kwamadivayisi. Okuqukethwe, ukuhlanganiswa kanye nokufometha amaseli ngokwezifiso ukuhlala etafuleni lendawo oya kuyo. Amasethingi afaneleka ngokuzenzakalelayo angashintsha usayizi obonisiwe.
tables.stylePreserveHint: Izitayela zigcina okusunguliwe kwakho, amaseli ahlanganisiwe, nosayizi womugqa nekholomu.
tables.summaryHint: Ibala ikholomu ngayinye ngokwehlukana. Amangqamuzana angenalutho futhi angenazinombolo ayeqiwa. Umugqa ohlanganisiwe uqukethe izinombolo ezingaguquki; bala kabusha ngemva kokushintsha amanani omthombo.
tables.weightsHint: Osayizi bahlobene. Inani elingu-2 lisebenzisa indawo ephindwe kabili kunelingu-1; itafula ligcina usayizi walo uwonke.
